name: g_box_top

It is the middle of the night: there is no daylight and no sun; the small phone flashlight is the only light, its beam falls off quickly, and the snow-dusted concrete around the box fades into dim blue-grey darkness toward the edges of the frame. Snowflakes on the cardboard rim, crisp shadows inside the box. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, signage, labels, logos, brand marks, screen interfaces or watermarks anywhere in the image; every tag, label area, screen and paper is blank.
